description:
Create a new multi-location scraping campaign.

Campaigns orchestrate Google Maps searches across multiple locations with optional website scraping and email verification. The backend automatically selects the appropriate WindMill workflow:

- Maps + Site + Verify: Full pipeline (default)
- Maps + Site: Skip email verification
- Maps only: Quick business search without site scraping

Provide a search query, country code, and optionally a workflow config to control which steps run.

SMARTLEAD EXPORT (push leads to an outreach campaign automatically): set workflow.smartlead = { enabled: true, connection_id, remote_campaign_id }. When enabled, the campaign's VERIFIED leads are pushed into that SmartLead campaign automatically when the run finishes (no separate push step). You MUST discover the two ids first: call list_outreach_connections (→ connection_id) then list_outreach_campaigns(connection_id) (→ remote_campaign_id). Those two tools live in the SpiderMail slice / kitchen-sink @spideriq/mcp. field_map is optional (backend defaults already map location + VayaPin pin_name). Only leads with a verified email are exported; set only_with_vayapin_seo:true to restrict to businesses that got a VayaPin SEO pin.

SCOPING US ZIP CAMPAIGNS ("state = country"): the US is too large to scrape whole. To run a US ZIP campaign, scope it to ONE STATE: set filter = { mode: "regions", admin_regions: ["Texas"], include_postcodes: true }. Discover valid state names with list_regions(country_code="US") (or list_countries, which lists the 50 states as country-equivalent units). One state runs every ZIP in it as its own Maps search — list_regions returns each state's postcode_count so you can size it first. Scoping a postcode (ZIP) run to all of the US — or omitting the state — is rejected by the API (422, >10K location cap). Pick exactly one state per campaign.

filter.description: Location filter configuration. For a US ZIP campaign, scope to ONE state: { mode: "regions", admin_regions: ["Texas"], include_postcodes: true }.

admin_regions.description: US state name(s) to scope a "regions" campaign to, e.g. ["Texas"]. Use exactly ONE state per campaign (single-state model). Discover valid names via list_regions(country_code="US").

include_postcodes.description: Opt in to postcode (ZIP) locations (default false = cities only). When true on a state-scoped US campaign, every ZIP runs as its own Maps search. All-US ZIP runs are rejected (422 / >10K cap) — scope to one state.

mode.description: Location selection mode. "regions" = scope to one US state (admin_regions). "city" = one city's ZIPs (parent_city). "all"/"population" = country-wide cities (ZIPs only if include_postcodes).

parent_city.description: Narrow to a single city (required for mode "city"; optional elsewhere).

workflow.description: Workflow configuration to control which pipeline steps run

smartlead.description: SmartLead export (FINALIZE step). When enabled, the campaign's VERIFIED leads are pushed to the chosen SmartLead campaign automatically at completion. Discover the ids first with list_outreach_connections + list_outreach_campaigns.

enabled.description: Push verified leads to SmartLead when the campaign finishes (default: false)

limit.description: Push at most N new leads (trims to the account cap instead of failing)

only_with_vayapin_seo.description: Only push leads that have a VayaPin SEO pin (default: false)

remote_campaign_id.description: Target SmartLead campaign id — from list_outreach_campaigns

social_media_enrichment.description: Social Media Enrichment fallback. When a business has no verified email, recovers its public social-media contact info and writes it back to the lead. Only takes effect for clients whose plan includes Social Media Enrichment (an owner-granted entitlement); ignored otherwise. Default ON (opt-out) for entitled clients.

enabled.description: Enable Social Media Enrichment for this campaign (default: true for entitled clients). Set false to skip.

max_pages.description: Max pages to crawl per site

vayapin.description: VayaPin publish stage. Publishes a PERMANENT public profile on cs.vayapin.com for each business with a website (deleting the campaign does NOT remove them). Set enabled explicitly — never rely on the default.

enabled.description: Publish VayaPin map profiles for this campaign

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: create_campaign
